name: The Workplace
overview: Scripture instructs believers to recognize and submit to governing authorities as they are established by God, highlighting the divine order present even in workplace structures. At the same time, Christians are called to serve Christ above pleasing men, ensuring their work honors God rather than merely human approval. Living worthy of the Lord involves being fruitful in every good work and growing in the knowledge of God, demonstrating that the workplace is a vital arena for faithful service and spiritual growth.
